(function() {
    var LR = "class.newbox@tag.li";
    var API = "https://www.69shuba.com/modules/article/search.php";

    var isCF = function(h) {
        return /_cf_chl_opt|cf_chl_prog|cf-browser-verification|challenge-form|Just a moment|Checking your browser|\/verify\.php/i.test(String(h));
    };
    var isLimit = function(h) {
        return /间隔时间不得少于|間隔時間不得少於|两次搜索的间隔|兩次搜索的間隔/.test(String(h));
    };
    var isShort = function(h) {
        return /搜索关键字请不要少于|搜索關鍵字請不要少於/.test(String(h));
    };
    var parse = function(h) {
        if (!h) return null;
        java.setContent(h);
        var l = java.getElements(LR);
        return (l != null && l.size() > 0) ? l : null;
    };

    var html = String(result || "");
    var list = parse(html);
    if (list) return list;

    if (isShort(html)) throw new Error("关键词太短, 中文至少两个字");
    if (isLimit(html)) throw new Error("站点限制搜索频率, 请隔几秒再搜");
    if (!isCF(html)) return null;

    var key = java.get("69key");
    var vUrl = API + "?searchkey=" + java.encodeURI(key, "gbk") + "&searchtype=all&page=1";
    var r = java.startBrowserAwait(vUrl, "69书吧 · 人机验证", false);
    list = parse(r ? String(r.body() || "") : "");
    if (list) return list;

    var req = API + ',{"method":"POST","body":"searchkey=' + key + '&searchtype=all&page=1","charset":"gbk"}';
    var h2 = String(java.ajax(req) || "");
    if (isCF(h2)) throw new Error("Cloudflare 未放行, 请重新搜索一次");
    if (isLimit(h2)) throw new Error("站点限制搜索频率, 请隔几秒再搜");
    return parse(h2);
})()
</js>
